land.text: Egypt, held by Nectanebo I after he deposed Nefaarud II in 380

capitals.name: Mendes (Tell el-Ruba)
capitals.note: Infobox: Capital: Mendes. The coordinates are the researcher's (the gazetteer has no Mendes).

rulers.name: Nefaarud II
rulers.note: Reigned four months before Nectanebo I deposed him.

correction.text: Egypt: the page says Hakor "successfully resisted Persian attempts to reconquer Egypt" and names no territory outside it

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe; Cliopatria has no Twenty-ninth Dynasty (its Thirtieth row begins -383, three years before this dynasty ends). The page gives no area or frontier and mentions no holding in the Levant, Cyrenaica, Sinai or Phoenicia. Whole Egypt at confidence 2.

region.text: Egypt, the whole Nile Valley and Delta

ledger.note: 398: Nefaarud I of Mendes founds the Twenty-ninth Dynasty. He defeated Amyrtaeus "in open battle, and later putting him to death at Memphis"; the infobox gives Mendes as capital and Nefaarud I 398–393.

380: Nectanebo I deposes Nefaarud II and the Twenty-ninth Dynasty ends. The page: "disestablished upon the overthrow of Nefaarud II in 380 BC"; he was "deposed and likely killed by Nectanebo I after ruling for only 4 months". [Reviewer me-03-x, 2026-10-19] Counterpart thirtieth-dynasty-of-egypt added: the page says Nefaarud II was deposed by Nectanebo I; me-03-c's Thirtieth Dynasty found event of 380 names this dynasty.

wars.name: Hakor's resistance to Persia
wars.outcome: Hakor "successfully resisted Persian attempts to reconquer Egypt", supported by Athens until the Peace of Antalcidas in 387 and by Evagoras, "the rebel king of Cyprus".
wars.note: The page gives no campaign years; -393..-380 are Hakor's reign.

notes: Eighteen years, no Cliopatria row; written from two pages as the dynasty me-03-c names as predecessor of the Thirtieth. The page spells the founder Nefaarud, not Nepherites. It does not say Nectanebo I founded the Thirtieth Dynasty, only that it succeeded; me-03-c has the 380 founding (November per its dossier). Cliopatria's Thirtieth Dynasty shape of -383 therefore overlaps this dynasty by three years: that is its own problem, reviewed in me-03-c. Mendes is a name the gazetteer lacks (only capitals use it).
